questions.question: A business sells 60,000 bottles in a year. The whole market buys 500,000 bottles. Calculate its market share, and calculate its revenue if each bottle sells for $20. (4 marks)
Construct a product life cycle diagram for a product now in maturity, showing both sales and profit and marking where an extension strategy would be applied. (4 marks)
Discuss whether a business entering the reusable bottle market should adopt a niche strategy rather than a mass market one. (8 marks)
Explain one way in which improving the aesthetics of a product may affect the other two elements of the design mix. (4 marks)
Assess whether building a strong brand is the best use of a marketing budget for a business selling reusable bottles. (10 marks)
Evaluate which pricing strategy a business should adopt when launching a reusable bottle into a market where several established rivals already sell a similar product. (20 marks)

A producer can reach consumers at $19.20 through a retailer, keeping $4 a unit, or sell directly at $20 and keep $12. Analyse the factors the producer should consider before choosing to sell directly. (6 marks)
